proposed.text: A design uses Narra lumber, but the contractor proposes Lauan of the same dimensions. What source-supported design issue arises?

options.text: Narra and Lauan are listed in different Table 615.2-1 strength groups, so the table values must be rechecked before substitution.
The substitution is automatically acceptable because dimensions match.
Lauan is listed in a higher strength group than Narra.
Species group does not affect table lookup under NSCP Table 615.2-1.

rationale.correct: The checked table lists Narra under II. Moderately High Strength Group and Lauan under III. Medium Strength Group. Substitution requires rechecking the table basis.
rationale.a: Not selected: Different listed groups require source-based rechecking before substitution.
rationale.b: Not selected: same dimensions do not make different species groups interchangeable.
rationale.c: Not selected: Lauan is not higher than Narra in the checked anchor.
rationale.d: Not selected: species group is the table lookup basis.
rationale.takeaway: A species substitution is a table-lookup change, not a cosmetic change.
